*LSTM* -> separate the memory from it's exposure

additional state c -> cell state that carries information through time 
hidden state exposes the information

+ f -> retain previous memory
+ i -> write new mem to c
+ o -> expose memory to h

*encoder-decoder* model 

encoder -> encode information through time in the hidden state -> then it can get used to predict something 

in general though we want to generate a sequence of tokens -> another model that "interprets" this hidden state rapresentation to produce a seq of output

the model needs to predict the end of token to stop producing new tokens 

the problem is that we use only the last hidden state to decode the new sequence 

ideal case model that can select which information to use not just the last state

look all previous hidden states -> we may try to learn weights to say which hiddend state is relevant to which prediction 

*attention* -> use all hidden state -> attention weights -> prob for each hidden state to tell us how relevant it is 

additive attention -> 1 vector per timestamp , in trnasformer no seq to se
